title: Estate Services Note: Rate Adjustment for the Wait of a Later Allocation Retired for an Estate
content:
# Rate Adjustment for the Wait of a Later Allocation

**Estate services note — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** For a later distribution-margin allocation retired for an estate, the estate discount rate is moved by how long the later allocation has waited, the calendar days from the booking date of the allocation to the retirement:

| Wait, in calendar days | Change to the estate discount rate |
|---|---|
| no more than 90 | -0.25 percentage points (a quarter point lower) |
| more than 90 and no more than 365 | unchanged |
| more than 365 | 0.5 percentage points added |

The booking date is the date of the allocation entry on the deceased member's capital account; the retirement date is the date the row is booked for the estate.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Allocation booked | Retired for the estate | Wait | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-03 | 2026-08-01 | 90 days | -0.25 points |
| 2026-05-03 | 2026-08-02 | 91 days | unchanged |
| 2025-08-01 | 2026-08-01 | 365 days | unchanged |
| 2025-08-01 | 2026-08-02 | 366 days | 0.5 points added |

**Worked figure (hypothetical rate).** A row whose rate is 5.0 percent becomes 4.75 percent after a wait of 60 days and 5.5 percent after a wait of 400 days. The change is added in percentage points, never as a percent of the rate.
